nom: ANUA Heartleaf Pore Control Cleansing Oil

segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers report fewer breakouts, less visible sebum and pore congestion, and no drying effect from the oil.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers describe the cleanser as hydrating and non-stripping, with several saying their pores cleared without any tightness or flaking.
segments.combination: The one combination/mixed-skin reviewer with acne tendencies found it cleaned effectively without worsening large pores.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: many report no irritation, calmed redness or reduced congestion, while others (including reactive or acne-prone sensitive skin) describe breakouts or a burned/damaged barrier.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers (including perimenopausal and post-menopausal users) report smaller-looking pores, firmer or more radiant skin, and relief from hormonal back acne.
segments.normal: A reviewer with no stated issues (no makeup, not acne-prone) reports the product reduced congestion without causing dryness or irritation.

concerns.spots: Numerous reviewers with acne-prone or previously clear skin report sudden whiteheads, cystic breakouts, or scarring, sometimes severe enough to need medical or dermatological treatment; conversely, many acne-prone reviewers, including some describing severe or hormonal acne, report no new breakouts and even clearing of existing acne.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers highlight reduced blackheads and whiteheads on the nose/T-zone with regular massage-in use over weeks to months; one reviewer says it did not remove any blackheads or whiteheads at all.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers report less visible sebum, smaller-looking pores and better oil control, with no reports of increased oiliness.
concerns.barrier: Most sensitive or reactive-skin reviewers report no irritation and calm, hydrated skin, but a minority describe barrier damage, burning, or the need to repair the skin barrier after use.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with redness around the nose reports it was calmed after use; no other redness-specific reports are mentioned.
concerns.dehydration: Dry-skin reviewers consistently describe the product as leaving skin soft, smooth and hydrated rather than dry or tight, with no reports of increased dryness.
concerns.aging: Mature-skin reviewers report smaller-looking pores, firmer and more radiant-looking skin with regular use, with no negative reports specific to aging skin.

aspects.libelle: Leaves oily residue requiring double cleanse
Removes waterproof makeup and mascara effectively
Soft, smooth skin feel after rinsing
Minimizes appearance of pores over time

extraits.texte: Used this product for maybe 3 weeks and it gave me the worst cystic acne of my life (im 26 y/o) everywhere on my face. So painful and gross with all the whiteheads. Have not had bad acne since high school. I think i had to use a whole sheet of pimple patches a week. My skin has finally recovered after 3 months since use but now have all this scarring i have to deal with...

First use i knew this was next level good. I have tried many make up removing skin cleaning oils. They usually make my skin feel super gross very greasy- or painfully dry. If I use them in my eye area, it actually gets like an oil film over my eye that makes it a little hard to see and or burns my eyes. This doesnt do any of that!! This removed all face products woth 1 application and about 90% of my eye makeup. I wear very heavy eye makeup so the mascara is hard to remove. This washes off with water on a face towel. My skin feels completely fine and normal afterwards, which is super uncommon for me. I loved it. I ordered another bottle immediately. But then I let her reviews and I kept seeing people saying it's causing cystic acne so I held off on a review to make sure that withh daily use this didnt cause any issues. I have sensitive, extreme acne prone skin, and this has worked beautfully for me. No acne or skin irritation at all. 10/10 i recomend.

Such a good pre cleanse oil! I have super dry sensitive acne prone skin that is very clog prone, and this oil doesn't set off any of those issues. Anua is an amazing brand in general, and I'm glad I started using more of their stuff. I see a huge difference in my skin!
This works great for me. People seem not to like it but ive never had a problem with it. I have dry, eczema prone, sensitice skin. It has shrunken my pores for sure!! No breakouts.

extraits.titre: I will buy this product again
extraits.texte: This Anua Heartleaf pore control cleansing oil is part of a 2-step cleansing routine for my skin and it works really well. I have very sensitive skin which is due in part to Hormone Replacement therapy for post menopause. I find when I start with this oil based cleanser and after a thorough rinse my skin felt great, but the key is to follow it up with a gentle cleanser. Never skip that last step as you may find your skin responding with unwanted acne. I have been impressed with the appearance of my skin after daily use as my pores look almost nonexistent. So, the end result is that my skin looks firmer and more radiant.

I'm so surpriaed by the negative reviews. This has not caused any acne for me, and has done quite the opposite. I've had perimenopausal back acne for 4 years and nothing gets rid of it - not even prescription creams - UNTIL THIS! In a little over one week all of those thousands of tiny bumps (and some big pimples) on my back were completely gone and it has been silky smooth for over two months now. Wish i would have tried this product sooner and i just can't believe I suffered for years when i courl have been usng this cleanser. I use it on my face too and my skin looks amazing and fresh. Highly recommend!

I ordered this full size because I fell in love with the travel size, which I received as fgwp, the thing is that I used the travel size just once a week (on the weekends when I wear makeup) and I loved how it removed my makeup (even waterproof mascara), ok! So I ordered the full she and started using it daily to remove my sunscreen and yes I double cleanse and I did wet my hands and emulsified before rinsing and going with my water base regular face wash, it's been let's say almost 2 weeks and I started noticing some texture in my forehead buuuuut suddenly I woke up with this TERRIBLE reaction, acne type of breakouts in my whole face, some hurt, some itch, some look swollen. I'm now trying to recover my skin, with minimal tried skin care (just face wash, sunscreen am and face wash light lotion pm), I'm scared because this is the first time this happens to me, I used to have severe acne in my teenager years, now I'm 42 and having this experience makes me think that I need to be more careful when using new products. Wonderful product but NOT FOR MY SKIN 🥲
